Container.Name: ReadAIrr
Container.Overview: ReadAIrr is an audiobook and ebook library manager with Readarr-compatible workflows, configurable metadata sources, narrator evidence tools, speech-to-text assisted matching, and optional PostgreSQL backing storage.
Container.Description: ReadAIrr manages audiobook and ebook collections, scans existing libraries, imports releases from download clients, and provides narrator-focused matching workflows. The production release track is recommended for most users. To opt into validation or development builds, change the Repository tag to ghcr.io/readairr/app:val or ghcr.io/readairr/app:dev and set the Release Track field to the same value. SQLite is used by default. PostgreSQL is optional and can be enabled by setting the advanced PostgreSQL variables to a reachable database with main, log, and cache databases.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: ReadAIrr web interface. Only change the host port if 8787 is already used on your Unraid server.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Download client output path as seen by ReadAIrr.

Config.Name: Audiobooks
Config.Description: Primary audiobook library path. Use /audiobooks as the root folder inside ReadAIrr.

Config.Name: Audiobooks Compatibility Path
Config.Description: Optional compatibility mount for libraries already configured to use /media/audiobooks.

Config.Name: Unraid Share Compatibility Path
Config.Description: Optional compatibility mount for imports or root folders that reference the Unraid-style path inside the container.

Config.Name: Umask
Config.Description: File creation umask used by ReadAIrr.

Config.Name: Release Track
Config.Description: ReadAIrr update track. Valid values are prod, val, and dev. Keep this aligned with the Repository tag selected above.

Config.Name: Update Mechanism
Config.Description: Docker installs should be updated by Unraid pulling a new image, not the built-in updater.

Config.Name: Automatic Built-In Updates
Config.Description: Keep false for Docker and Unraid installs.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Host
Config.Description: Optional PostgreSQL host. Leave blank to use the default SQLite database.
